extracted.intended_audience: SBIR/STTR small business applicants, subawardees, and grant/budget preparers (grant writers and institutional grants administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the budget, budget justification, and research plan attachments for an SBIR/STTR (PHS 398) application, including subaward budgets, SBIR/STTR eligibility questions, and required Research Plan sections. Covers personnel effort reporting, materials/supplies justification, indirect costs, human embryonic stem cell reporting, and Specific Aims/Research Strategy content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel effort reporting (Senior/Key & Other Personnel)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Proposed % effort and % effort on existing grants for the proposed budget period for each Senior/Key person and other personnel (e.g., 'Holger Karsunky PD/PI 10% 90%', 'Greg Boucher RA 50% 50%').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List names, project roles, and proposed percent effort; include explicit justification of responsibilities (e.g., Research Associate 50% time will harvest tissues, isolate HSC, generate MPC, perform flow cytometry, colony assays, cryopreservation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fringe benefits justification
rubrics_metrics.description: State the fringe benefits rate and what it covers (e.g., 'Fringe benefits, which are 38.94% of salary requested, cover payroll taxes, employee fringe benefits, and workers compensation insurance.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the percentage used, items covered by fringe, and apply to requested salary amounts in the budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment threshold and listing (Section C)
rubrics_metrics.description: List items and dollar amount for each equipment item exceeding $5,000 and indicate when 'This proposal includes no equipment budget.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For subawards and main budgets, provide an equipment description and list each item > $5,000 with funds requested; otherwise state N/A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel cost justification (Section D)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide travel requests and justify trips (e.g., two trips to academic partner; costs based on average non-refundable economy ticket, two nights per trip at GSA lodging rate and GSA per diems).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify purpose, frequency, and basis for cost estimates (airfare, lodging rates, per diems) and where travel funds may be used (partner meetings, conferences).

rubrics_metrics.name: Materials and supplies major cost factors (Section F.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe and justify major materials and supplies costs (e.g., recombinant growth factors, media, supplements, culture vessels, fluorochrome-labeled antibodies, procurement of mice up to specified numbers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerate major categories, frequency/replacement schedule (e.g., 12–15 antibody replacements per year), and vendor options; quantify number of animals and per-animal costs when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward budgeting and justification (Section F.5 / Subawards/Consortium)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include subaward budget amounts (direct and indirect), provide the subaward's budget justification and a detailed budget (e.g., 'The budget for the academic partner is $ ($ direct costs plus $ indirect costs). Their budget justification and their detailed budget are provided.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach subaward budget forms mirroring main budget sections (A–H), list senior/key persons and other personnel, and include justification for personnel, supplies, core fees, and animal costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect costs reporting (Section H)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the G&A (indirect) rate and the basis/agreement (e.g., 'The G&A rate, currently at %, is used ... The current rate is based upon a bilateral rate agreement date Nov 6, 2012 between Cellerant Therapeutics, Inc and HHS/ASPR/ACMG.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify cognizant federal agency/office, audit/review frequency (e.g., reviewed annually by an auditor), and what services indirect costs support (vivarium operations, IT, accounting, procurement, HR).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget section structure (A–J) and required line items
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare the Research & Related Budget with standard sections: A Senior/Key Person; B Other Personnel; C Equipment; D Travel; E Participant/Trainee Support Costs; F Other Direct Costs (Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards, Equipment Rental, etc.); G Direct Costs; H Indirect Costs; I Total Direct and Indirect Costs; J Fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fill each section with totals and detail rows (e.g., Number of Participants/Trainees, Mouse Costs by Aim), and include cumulative budget totals and totals per section for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward budget mirrors main budget sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Subaward budget forms must include analogous sections (A–K) for the subaward organization: senior/key personnel, other personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs, indirect costs, and totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete subaward-specific fields (organization name, DUNS, start/end dates, budget period) and attach subaward budget justification file(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget justification attachments rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach budget justification files where requested and note file naming and mime type restrictions (e.g., 'BudgetJustificationDomen.pdf; MimeType: application/pdf (Only attach one file.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow form instructions about number and type of files; include narrative justifications in the attached document for personnel, supplies, core fees, histology, animal costs, sorting time, and travel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal and animal-cost justification (mouse purchasing and per diems)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide numbers and justification for animal use and costs (e.g., 'We expect to use approx. 700 mice', typical experiments require 50 mice, mouse purchase prices average $20, cage cost $0.54 per day, estimate number of cages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State strains/vendors, vendor options, expected cage occupancy and durations, calculations for per diem/caging costs, and link to experimental aims (hosts, donors, graft donors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consumables and core facility fees justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Justify consumables (plasticware, media, IgG blocking, surgical supplies) and core fees (histology, flow cytometry sort time) with expected usage and numbers (e.g., 16 one-hour sorts budgeted at core facility; histology of 150 samples including H&E and two immune stains).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give unit use estimates, why the core is needed, and tie costs to experimental milestones and sample throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims content and structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims should state the problem, overarching hypotheses, discrete aims and associated milestones (e.g., aim statements and 'Milestone: No luminal occlusion and maintenance of epithelium in allogeneic (MP-matched) tracheal transplants').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include significance and innovation rationale within or adjacent to the Aims section and ensure aims are testable and linked to measurable milestones/outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy sections to address (Significance, Innovation, Approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Strategy must include (A) Significance, (B) Innovation, and (C) Approach and discuss clinical relevance, gaps in current methods, novelty of approach, and experimental approach and feasibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss background literature, limitations of existing methods, how the proposed approach changes the field, and provide experimental plans and rationale for translation and development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Milestone specification and measurable endpoints
rubrics_metrics.description: Define clear, measurable milestones tied to aims (example: 'No luminal occlusion and maintenance of epithelium' as the milestone for tracheal transplants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use objective, measurable biological or experimental readouts as milestones to assess progress toward each aim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human embryonic stem cell (HESC) reporting requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: If the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells, list the registration number of the specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or check the box indicating that 'one from the registry will be used' (or state 'Specific stem cell line cannot be referenced at this time. One from the registry will be used').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide registry identifiers or explicitly indicate intent to use a registry-listed line as required on the PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan Attachments required list
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach applicable Research Plan sections: Specific Aims; Research Strategy; Protection of Human Subjects; Inclusion of Women and Minorities; Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table; Inclusion of Children; Vertebrate Animals; Consortium/Contractual Arrangements; Letters of Support; Resource Sharing Plan(s); Appendix, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure each applicable attachment is present and uploaded under the correct Research Plan slot. The form lists explicit attachment slots and names (e.g., '1241-SpecificAimsSTTR2012v2').

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR program eligibility and certification questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer program-specific yes/no certification questions: small business eligibility at time of award; subcontracts with federal labs; HUBZone status; whether all R&D will be performed in the U.S.; prior equivalent proposals or awards; permission for government to disclose project title and contact info if not awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide attachments or explanations where required (e.g., if 'No' to an eligibility item) and follow agency-specific instructions for combined/dual SBIR/STTR submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercialization Plan requirement for Phase II/Fast-Track
rubrics_metrics.description: If submitting a Phase II or Phase I/Phase II Fast-Track Application, include a Commercialization Plan 'in accordance with the agency announcement and/or agency-specific instructions.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach commercialization history or plan files as required and follow agency-specific formatting/instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure Permission Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the Government is permitted to disclose the title of proposed project and applicant contact information to organizations that may be interested in contacting you if the application does not result in an award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer yes/no and attach explanation if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipated personnel counts and company staffing
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide anticipated number of personnel to be employed at the organization at the time of award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the requested numeric fields and ensure internal consistency with budgeted personnel effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR PD/PI employment & effort rules
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether PD/PI will have primary employment with the small business at time of award and whether PD/PI has a formal appointment/commitment and will devote at least 10% effort to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer program-specific questions (SBIR vs STTR rules differ) and attach supporting documentation when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: STTR required minimum work-share percentages
rubrics_metrics.description: For STTR applications, indicate whether the small business will perform at least 40% of the work and the research institution will perform at least 30% of the work ('In the joint research and development proposed in this project, does the small business perform at least 40% of the work and the research institution named in the application perform at least 30% of the work?').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a work allocation plan and supporting documentation showing percent effort and budget distribution between partners.
